integrity: The claim is proved by exact symmetry covariance, differentiation, and a 2-by-2 matrix identity. No numerical experiment or unpublished external certificate is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on C2 regularity of the bound-pair dispersion at the stated quasi-momenta and, for the mass-tensor identity, invertibility of the Hessian. Equal valley occupation is not proved. No claim is made about higher-order isotropy.
title: Quarter-turn covariance and equal-valley isotropy of exchange-pair effective masses
